session_evidence: Company IR release: results 2026-09-03 'after the close of the market', call/webcast the same day beginning 5:00 p.m. - https://ir.aob.com/news-releases/news-release-details/american-outdoor-brands-first-quarter-fiscal-2027-financial
where_to_look: AOUT's fiscal Q1 is the same May-July 2026 window as SWBI's, and the NICS/NSSF-adjusted turn (June +6.12%, July +3.85% vs 3-year average - first two consecutive positives since Jan-2024) touches AOUT's shooting-accessories brands, though more weakly than SWBI's firearms. Test the read-across rather than assuming it

AOUT is really two businesses - Shooting Sports and Outdoor Lifestyle - and the outdoor/cooking (MEAT!, BUBBA) side keys off summer weather and camping demand, not NICS. Look for the segment split, which is the part consensus (2 estimates) collapses

Amazon/e-commerce channel share: AOUT discloses e-commerce as a distinct channel and its DTC growth is observable through Amazon best-seller-rank and review-count trajectories on its flagship SKUs through July 2026

Tariff exposure is disproportionate here - AOUT sources a high share of accessories from Asia and has less pricing power than a firearms OEM. The gross-margin and price-increase commentary is the lever
$125m market cap, no options chain, 2 estimates, and a substantial net-cash balance relative to the cap - check the cash and buyback pace, which can be a larger share of the move than earnings

The tariff cost headwind for Asia-sourced consumer goods
